capabilities: Run SQL queries against indexed vault content, frontmatter, tables, tasks, and links
Apply INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE changes to files with before/after preview
Render results as SlickGrid tables, Chart.js charts, FullCalendar calendars, or Markdown tables
Turn natural-language requests into SQL queries via a configured provider
Define reusable SQL views and custom SQL functions in JavaScript
extras: Documentation site is referenced but its content is not included. Natural-language queries send the database schema and property names to a user-configured provider URL. The README details network requests: WASM download for sql.js, optional CDN-only loading via jsDelivr, and read-only CSV/JSON downloads for remote data blocks. Includes an API guide for third-party plugin developers and an Obsidian CLI command. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's search cannot run structured queries across note content and metadata, nor write query results back into files.

relations.evidence: Render query results as Chart.js visualizations
Render query results as a FullCalendar calendar
Results render in a sortable SlickGrid table.
Downloads the WASM for the sql.js version installed when this plugin was built.

requires.name: natural-language provider URL configured in settings

summary: SQL engine that runs SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements on notes, properties, tasks, and links, rendering results as tables, charts, or calendars.
